Microcephaly, seizures and developmental delay, known as MCSZ, is an uncommon autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder linked to a bifunctional enzyme named polynucleotide-kinase-3'-phosphatase (PNKP).
We confirmed, through RNA-seq, that c. 1299-1G>A results in exon 15 skipping and intron 14 retention.
Both variants led to a truncated protein and may affect protein stability and enzyme activity.
